svg.text: FCCM with supervisory haircuts • EU CRR Arts. 220–227 • Basel CRE22 • Prototype v0.2.0
Exposure value: choose the route before aggregating
E* = max {0, ΣEᵢ − ΣCⱼ + 0.4 E_net + 0.6 E_gross / √N + A_FX}
E_net = |Σₗ qₗ hₗ| E_gross = Σₗ |qₗ| hₗ A_FX = Σₖ |fₖ| HFX,k
qₗ: signed net security position; hₗ ≥ 0. fₖ: net non-settlement currency position.
N counts non-zero groups with |qₗ| ≥ 10% of the largest |q|; small groups stay in sums.
Prototype: if N = 0, gross must be 0 and its contribution is set to 0.
E*ₜ = max {0, E(1 + H_E) − C(1 − H_C − H_FX)}
Calculate each transaction separately, then sum E*ₜ; no cross-trade offset.
Use value-weighted basket haircuts and the applicable FX mismatch adjustment.
E: exposure before protection. C: recognised collateral. Values in one currency.
Shown without maturity mismatch; that adjustment is outside the prototype.
Haircut scaling, holding periods and eligibility
CRR Art. 226: N_R is days between revaluations;
the prototype uses its remargining-frequency input.
Use the applicable minimum T_M before scaling.
Mixed sets: 10 in the prototype (Basel convention).
Large / illiquid sets: at least 20; disputes may double it.
Eligible collateral and enforceable netting required.
0% haircut only if all Art. 227 conditions hold.
Supervisory base haircuts — percentages, 10 business days, daily revaluation
Eligible funds: weighted underlying haircut; if unknown,
¹ Art. 224 Table 1: issuer categories in Art. 197(1)(b), (c)/(d), and (h), respectively. Eligibility conditions still apply; short-term ratings are not shown.
Risk weights, capital and implementation boundaries
RWA = E* × RW; minimum total capital = 8% × RWA
RW comes from the counterparty credit-risk rules, not the haircut table.
Prototype classes: sovereign, institution, corporate and QCCP.
8% excludes capital buffers, Pillar 2 and other prudential requirements.
INVALID or INCOMPLETE sets: exposure is withheld.
Parameter or risk-weight overrides: WHAT-IF classification.
REGULATORY is a parameter-match label, not regulatory certification.
The prototype carries both CRR and BCBS regimes and a QCCP class, although the recorded first scope is CRR bilateral SFTs. Mixed sets use 10 BD in both regimes.
Commodity repos, maturity mismatch, VaR / IMM, leverage ratio, CVA and CRE56 haircut floors are not implemented. Source-by-source certification remains outstanding.
Sources: CRR consolidated 26 June 2026, Arts. 92, 197, 206, 220, 223–227, 285; Basel CRE22; docs/methodology/PROTOTYPE.md and SFT_Formulas.bas.
Simplified calculation reference • Prototype v0.2.0 • Reviewed 26 October 2026 • No claim of a validated regulatory method.
